dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent irregular O-shaped structures exhibit high-intensity white perimeters with sharp gradient transitions to dark interiors. The perimeters are non-uniform in thickness, with the most dorsal annulus showing a flattened superior edge and the posterior-lateral annulus displaying a broken 'C' geometry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of localized white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the interstitial spaces between the three largest central annuli and extending toward the lower-right margin.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four primary macro-annuli form an asymmetrical quadrilateral on the dorsal-lateral surface, with a fifth smaller centroid positioned inferiorly, creating a secondary triangular relationship with the two lowermost primary nodes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, localized red-pigmented punctate mark is visible on the lower-left ventral margin, contrasting with the surrounding dark grey epidermal tones.
other_distinctive_markers: The central-left section features a unique chain-like interlocking of two small annuli that share a segment of their high-intensity perimeters.
